blind.description: A stylized masonry wall section featuring a rounded archway opening. Constructed from warm tan-yellow stone blocks accented with dark grey stone trim bands along the piers, around the arch voussoirs, and just beneath the top coping layer. The structure is clean, fully solid, and sits flat directly on the floor without an extra base plinth.
blind.from_above: A simple rounded rectangular bar divided down the center into two tan stone blocks, with smooth rounded corners.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 7.5 to 8 feet tall (roughly 1.3 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
